recent_articles.title: Single-sex toilets must exclude transgender people, says EHRC | Gender | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Equality and Human Rights Commission (EHRC)** has released a new code of practice for public bodies, businesses, and service providers in England, Wales, and Scotland regarding single-sex facilities. The document acknowledges potential negative impacts on transgender individuals and encourages a broader conversation about inclusive access to facilities.
